description_en: You can call the CreateRDSToClickhouseDb operation to create a sync task for an ApsaraDB for ClickHouse Community-Compatible Edition cluster
description_zh: 调用CreateRDSToClickhouseDb接口创建云数据库ClickHouse社区兼容版同步任务
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse create-rds-to-clickhouse-db --db-cluster-id cc-2ze5zeyl721880000 --ck-user-name user1 --ck-password 123456Aa --rds-id rm-8vb989qj9roh00000 --rds-user-name user2 --rds-password 123456Rr --skip-unsupported true --syn-db-tables Schema_:_recommend_,_Tables_:_mr_platform_cpm_,_mr_platform_ecpm_,_p_monitor_record --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRDSToClickhouseDb

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The port number of the ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
parameters.name: clickhouse_port

parameters.help_en: The database account of the ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
parameters.help_zh: 云数据库ClickHouse的数据库账号
parameters.name: ck_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password for the database account of the ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
parameters.help_zh: 云数据库ClickHouse的数据库账号密码
parameters.name: ck_password

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance
parameters.name: rds_id

parameters.help_en: The port number of the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance
parameters.help_zh: 云数据库RDS MySQL的端口号
parameters.name: rds_port

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID of the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance
parameters.name: rds_vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The database account of the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance
parameters.help_zh: 云数据库RDS MySQL的数据库账号
parameters.name: rds_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password for the database account of the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance
parameters.help_zh: 云数据库RDS MySQL的数据库账号密码
parameters.name: rds_password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to skip unsupported table schemas. Valid values:

true: Skip.

false: Do not skip
parameters.help_zh:
是否忽略不支持同步的表结构，取值说明：

true：忽略。
false：不忽略
parameters.name: skip_unsupported

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of rows to sync per second
parameters.name: limit_upper

parameters.help_en: The internal endpoint of the ApsaraDB RDS instance
parameters.name: rds_vpc_url

ErrorMsg.description_en: The reason for the creation failure. This parameter is returned only if the value of the Status parameter is -1
ErrorMsg.description_zh: 当Status参数返回为-1时，返回创建失败的原因
ErrorMsg.example: ClickHouse exception, code: 49, host: 100.100.79.102, port: 14540; Code: 49, e.displayText() = DB::Exception: Logical error: there is no global context (version 20.8.17.25)n

RepeatedDbs.description_en: The duplicate tables in the sync task

items.description_en: The duplicate tables in the sync task. This parameter is returned only if the value of the Status parameter is 0
items.description_zh: 当Status返回为0时，返回创建同步任务中重复的表

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the task was created. Valid values:

1: The task was created.

0: The task failed to be created because of duplicate tables. The duplicate tables are returned in the RepeatedDbs parameter.

-1: The task failed to be created. The error message is returned in the ErrorMsg parameter
Status.description_zh:
创建是否成功，取值说明：
1：创建成功。
0：创建失败。同步任务中的表重复了，具体重复的表在RepeatedDbs参数中返回。
-1：创建失败。创建失败的原因在ErrorMsg参数中返回
